The MPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 is a government job opportunity for master's degree holders in related subjects.

The programme aims to recruit eligible candidates for the post of Assistant Professor in various subjects, including Sanskrit, Geography, Psychology, Law, Geology, and Yogic Science.
